title: Flex LNG – AGM Notice 2026
summary: Flex LNG is an LNG shipping company with a fleet of thirteen modern LNG carriers on the water, all with the latest generation two-stroke propulsion (MEGI and X-DF). Flex LNG is listed on New York Stock Exchange and Oslo Stock Exchange under the ticker FLNG.
body_markdown:
Hamilton, Bermuda


March 30, 2026


FLEX LNG LTD. (the “Company”) announces that its 2026 Annual General Meeting will be held on May 5, 2026. A copy of the Notice of Annual General Meeting and associated information including the Company’s 2025 Annual Report on Form 20-F can be found attached and on our website at www.flexlng.com.


The Board of Directors


FLEX LNG Ltd.
